game.name: br
game.description: Battle Royale: a shrinking-zone, last-team-standing elimination mode on the same paintbot engine as ctf/paintbot, config-gated by brMode:true. Sixteen entrant policies, one per duo team (red, blue, green, yellow, black, silver, ivory, pink, umber, rust, orange, plum, lime, navy, azure, peach), each fielding 2 agents on a generated giant flagless map - 32 seats total. One life, no respawn: lives/respawnTicks are never consulted for re-entry, a death is permanent for the rest of the round, exactly like a captured team going permanently out in classic play. The round ends the instant at most one team still has a living player - the survivor wins; a simultaneous final wipe is a draw. Hearts/flags never end or score a BR round even if a map has them (BR maps ship flagless). A closing rectangular zone - the map's own aspect ratio, scaled about a center drawn once per game - holds at full size, then shrinks through a schedule of phases (each {z, waitTicks, shrinkTicks, dps}: target scale, ticks held before shrinking, ticks to interpolate, and hit points per second dealt to anyone caught outside the current rect); standing outside for a full continuous second takes that phase's dps through the shield layer first, and the last phase holds forever once its shrink completes. If the clock runs out with more than one team standing, the round resolves by tiebreak instead of a draw: most living players wins, ties break on total damage dealt, and a full tie is a draw. Scoring is placement-based: the winner scores +1 per losing team (pot scoring also available); every OTHER team that made at least one attack or dealt damage - engagement-gated, so idling in a corner earns nothing beyond the flat loss floor - scores an added placement bonus by final rank (2nd best keyed highest, tapering to zero by around 12th, clamped to always stay strictly below the winner's own score). Core combat is otherwise identical to paintbot: fog-of-war vision decoupled from aim, hitscan gun with a windup and lightly fuzzed aim, a spray-can melee cone, one shield per team trading fire rate for +hp, med kits, grenades, and shouted 10-character callouts heard within a fifth of the field. Player observation coordinates are 1x map scale; the grenade throw is player-input bit 7 / value 128 (see docs/PROTOCOL.md).

tokens.description: One connection token per player slot, indexed by slot. BR always seats the full 16-duo, 32-seat roster.

players.description: One player display-name object per player slot, indexed by slot.

slots.description: Optional fixed player slot team, color, skin, and token settings.

team.description: Fixed team (one of the 16 BR teams) for this seat. With no team the seat is dealt slot mod 16.

skin.description: Cosmetic body-art skin for this slot's player. Rendering only: no gameplay effect and no observation-label change.

closedRoster.description: Reject players outside the configured token/slot roster.

minPlayers.description: Players needed before the game countdown starts. BR is designed to seat the full 32-seat, 16-duo roster.

lives.description: Lives per player. Ignored under brMode: true forces every seat's spare lives to 0 (a death is permanent), regardless of this value; kept for handicap interpolation only.

hitPoints.description: Hit points per life. Each shot removes one; at zero you die (permanently, under brMode).

respawnTicks.description: Ticks dead before respawning at home. Never consulted under brMode: true (no respawns).

gunRange.description: Maximum hitscan gun range in pixels.

fireCooldownTicks.description: Minimum ticks between shots (~0.5s at 24 ticks/s).

carrierSpeedPct.description: Movement speed percentage while carrying a heart. Moot on flagless BR maps; kept for schema parity with the shared engine.

playerBouncePct.description: Restitution percentage of player-player collisions; bodies are always solid.

aimTurnRate.description: Aim rotation speed in brads (256ths of a turn) per tick while a rotate button is held.

visionConeDeg.description: Vision cone half-angle in degrees around the aim angle.

visionBubble.description: Omnidirectional vision radius in pixels around each player, seen regardless of aim.

startWaitTicks.description: Lobby countdown ticks after enough players join.

lobbyJoinTimeoutTicks.description: Finite matches only: abort the lobby when the roster is still short of minPlayers after this many lobby ticks (24 ticks = 1s), charging the no-show seat via COGAME_PLAYER_FAILURE_URI. 0 = wait forever (default).

gameOverTicks.description: Game over display duration in ticks.

maxTicks.description: Maximum game ticks before the BR tiebreak (most living players, then damage dealt) resolves the round instead of an automatic draw. 0 means no limit.

fastMode.description: Advance frames early when all players report ready.

mapPath.description: Arena map identifier, used only when mapSpec is absent.

num_agents.description: Number of agent seats; must equal the player slot count (32 for BR).

fireWindupTicks.description: Ticks from trigger pull to the shot releasing. Aim locks at the pull.

teams.description: Active team count. Battle Royale always seats 16 duo teams.

mapLayout.description: Generated-map layout lock: sides, corners, or plus. Not used by BR maps, which are authored via mapSpec (16-spawn-group flagless terrain) rather than this knob; accepted for schema parity with the shared engine.

mapSeed.description: Terrain seed for mapPath gen/pool; -1 derives from the per-episode game seed. Superseded by mapSpec when present.

scoring.description: End-of-game reward rule. "classic": the winner scores +1 per losing team; BR additionally keys every engaged loser's reward on placement rank (see description). "pot": every team antes one point and the winner takes the whole pot, split evenly across losers.

mapSize.description: Generated-map size-class lock: small, standard, large, huge, or giant. Superseded by mapSpec when present; BR always plays a giant map.

handicaps.description: Per-team handicap that weakens a team, keyed by team name (any of the 16 BR teams). Each value is 0..1: 0 = normal, 1 = 50% of shots miss, 1 life, 1 hit point, half max speed; values in between interpolate linearly. Omitted teams are unhandicapped.

perkVocabulary.effect: 10% of landed gun shots deal 2 damage

perks.description: Per-team perk buffs, keyed by team name (any of the 16 BR teams). A team's value is a flat array of perk names (the whole duo shares them) or an object keyed by policy name pinning perks to that policy. Omitted teams have no perks.

perkMods.description: Perk magnitude overrides. Fractions are 0..1: scopeAim = fraction of aim deviation removed, grenadeRange/thrusterSpeed = extra range/speed, luckChance = chance a landed shot is lucky; armorHp/luckDamage are hit-point counts (0..100).

barrierPickups.description: Cardboard-barrier pickups per team, staged between base and center. A carried barrier places with the grenade button as a standing half-hex that blocks paint but not sight, takes 10 paintball hits, and is flattened by any cog that drives into it; carrying one excludes carrying a grenade. 0 disables the item (the default).

barrageMaxPerSec.description: Grenade-barrage endgame: the launch rate the bombardment ramps up to, in grenades/second across the whole board. 0 disables the mode; requires maxTicks > 0 when set. With the barrage on, the time limit no longer ends the game — it plays past 0:00 under full bombardment until one team is wiped. BR's default schedule uses the shrink zone, not the barrage, to close out a round; 0 (off) is the BR default.

barrageStartPerSec.description: Grenade-barrage launch rate at the latch, along the map edges, grenades/second.

barrageStartSec.description: Clock seconds remaining that latch the barrage on (30 = starts at 4:30 on a 5:00 clock).

barrageSaturateSec.description: Seconds from the latch until full saturation: whole board targeted at barrageMaxPerSec (30 = saturated exactly at 5:00 with the default start).

mapSpec.description: Full expanded map geometry (obstacles, spawn points, med kit/shield/spray/grenade pickups) as a JSON object. Pins an exact authored map, overriding mapPath/mapSeed/mapSize. Same format the replay config carries. BR maps are generated flagless with 16 spawnGroups (one per duo).

zonePhases.description: Battle-royale closing-zone schedule: a list of {z, waitTicks, shrinkTicks, dps} phases (docs/designs/BR_MAPGEN.md §4.3). z (0 < z <= 1) is the target scale relative to the full map, strictly decreasing phase over phase (including the implicit phase-0 value of 1.0); waitTicks holds the previous rect before shrinking; shrinkTicks linearly interpolates into the target; dps is hit points per continuous second spent outside the current rect (through the shield layer first). Omitted/empty (the engine default) turns the mode off entirely - no draw, no rect, no damage. At most 8 phases.

zoneCenter.description: Optional authored [x, y] map-pixel point the shrink zone closes on, overriding the default per-episode random draw. Only meaningful when zonePhases is non-empty.

brMode.description: Battle-royale elimination ruleset (docs/designs/BR_MAPGEN.md §1): no respawns (a death is permanent for the round), last team standing wins, flags never end or score the round, and a stalled timeout resolves by tiebreak (most living players, then total damage dealt) instead of an automatic draw. This manifest's whole purpose is BR play.

allowSeatTakeover.description: Allow a human client to take over a live bot-controlled seat mid-round (BR ships human seat takeover as a supported path).

allowDirectAim.description: Allow a seat's aim to be driven directly (human mouse/stick aim) instead of only the discrete rotate buttons. Required by allowAimAssist.

allowAimAssist.description: Snap a human's aim onto a live enemy's windup intercept when already close, within aimAssistConeBrads. Requires allowDirectAim: true; rejected otherwise.

allowCallouts.description: Allow the human-client grid-cell callout affordance on top of the base 10-character shout.

names.description: One player name or address per player slot.

scores.description: One scalar score per player slot.

win.description: One win flag per player slot.

team.description: One team name (red or blue) per player slot.

kills.description: One kill count per player slot.

deaths.description: One death count per player slot.

captures.description: One heart-capture count per player slot.

achievements.description: Achievement ids earned per player slot across the episode's games (win-gated; see the game.achievements catalog).

player.name: baseline
player.description: Minimal sprite-protocol baseline bot, BR-capable: hunts the nearest living enemy, retreats from the shrinking zone once its marker appears, and grabs whichever neutral pickup (med kit, shield, spray can, grenade) is nearest - no flag-carrying behavior, since BR maps run flagless. Image placeholder is replaced at deploy time.

variants.name: Battle Royale
variants.description: Sixteen-duo, 32-seat battle royale on a generated giant flagless map: one entrant policy per duo team, no respawns, last team standing wins. The zone holds at full size for 25s, then closes through 5 phases over roughly the next 2m20s, tightening from 75% to 17% of the map and ramping environmental damage from 0 to 12 hp/s outside it; a stalled timeout resolves by living-player count, then total damage dealt. Classic scoring: the winner scores +1 per losing team, and every OTHER team that made at least one attack or dealt damage scores an added placement bonus by final rank.
